 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale Campaign Delivers Record-Breaking Sales and Over 111M Coins in Cashback for ShopeeVIP Users
 Published on: 16 Nov 2026 11:25pm | Issuer: Shopee Singapore 
 Share
 Copy Make Media OutReach Newswire your preferred source on Google The excitement is still building through 17 November, as shoppers tune into Shopee Live, explore new finds and join the Aion V Luxury giveaway, while sellers and creators make the most of Shopee’s extended sales period.
 SINGAPORE – 
 Media OutReach Newswire – 16 November 2026 – Shopee’s 11.11 Big Sale has already broken its sales record. Shoppers have saved more than S$111M, while ShopeeVIP users have received over 111M coins in cashback. The campaign runs through 17 November, giving shoppers more time to catch the deals and join the celebrations.
 As of 11 November, Shopee Live and Shopee Video watch time had grown more than 5X YoY, while car giveaway participation had reached 3X YoY. Shoppers are spending more time discovering products through livestreams and video, and joining the giveaway for a chance to win an Aion V Luxury.
 That excitement is also creating new ways for sellers to reach shoppers. At Affiliates Connect on 6 November, Shopee recognised 32 Million Dollar Club affiliates, twice as many as last year. Each had generated at least US$1 million in sales during the qualifying year. So far during 11.11, they have generated close to S$4 million in sales, as creators help sellers introduce products and connect with shoppers.
 Chua Kel Jin, Director at Shopee Singapore, said : “We’re proud to see this 11.11 deliver record-breaking sales, and encouraged by the energy that is still carrying through the campaign. At its heart, 11.11 brings our community together around the best value and deals, while giving sellers and creators a platform to connect with shoppers and grow. With the sales period still open, there is more time for shoppers to join in and for businesses to build on what they have achieved so far.”
 SELLERS ARE MAKING THE MOST OF THE 11.11 SPOTLIGHT
 Local seafood brand Fassler Gourmet leaned further into streaming this year, working with more livestreamers and trying new offers, including soup bundles. By 10 November, before the 11.11 peak, Fassler had surpassed its previous 11.11 sales performance.
 Angela Wong, Sales & Marketing Manager at Fassler Gourmet, said : “We loved the response to 11.11 last year, so this time we wanted to up the ante with more livestreamers, giveaways and offers. Livestreams let creators tell the story behind our products and introduce the range, while bundles like our $11.11 Brand Box make it easier for shoppers to choose. They get a good deal and can try our bestsellers together.”
 Thai skincare brand Ingu joined Shopee Singapore in January 2026, making this its first 11.11 on the platform. During a three-hour Shopee Live with top streamer @Omfgwen, Ingu set a new single-livestream sales record, generating S$330K, and sold out of its products.
 Chayadhorn “Ing” Kitiyadisai, founder of Ingu, said : “I’m losing my voice after that livestream, but it was so worth it. Our team was on the phone throughout, calling the e-commerce team and warehouse to get more stock out. I’m so grateful to everyone who came to support us, and to Gwen and the Shopee Singapore team for making it happen.”
 LOCAL FASHION TAKES OFF ON LIVE AS BAKKWA APPEARS EARLY FOR CNY 
 These livestreams are also shaping what shoppers discover. Local Fashion GMV grew more than 75% YoY, largely driven by livestreams that bring collections from local labels such as Carrislabelle, Hollyhoque, Dear Lyla, Vanity Closet and Neonmello to shoppers. Fashion works especially well on screen, where shoppers can see how pieces fit and move, pick up styling ideas and ask sizing questions in real time.
 In food, bakkwa is also making an early appearance on shoppers’ CNY lists. On 10 November, 167 Bakkwa generated close to S$200K in one livestream, with its 5 Bacon + 1 Free Bacon bundle ranked #10 among top-selling items on Shopee Live and Shopee Video. With shoppers buying bakkwa months ahead of CNY, this points to festive shopping starting earlier and gives sellers a chance to put seasonal favourites in front of them before the holiday rush.
 There is still time to jump in, the 11.11 sale and car giveaway remain open through 17 November. ShopeeVIP subscribers can 
 register for a chance to win an Aion V Luxury electric SUV worth approximately S$68,000, with every S$30 spent on eligible purchases earning one chance in the draw. The prize excludes the Certificate of Entitlement, which will be borne by the winner. The winner will be announced on 26 November. Shop the 
 11.11 deals on Shopee before the sale ends.
 Hashtag: #Shopee About Shopee
 Shopee is the largest e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia and Taiwan, and is a leading e-commerce platform in Brazil. Shopee promotes an inclusive and sustainable digital ecosystem by enabling businesses to digitalise and grow their online presence, helping more people access and benefit from digital services, and uplifting local communities.
Shopee offers an easy, secure, and engaging experience that is enjoyed by millions of people daily. Shopee is also a key contributor to the digital economy, with a firm commitment to helping homegrown brands and entrepreneurs succeed in e-commerce.
Shopee is part of Sea Limited (NYSE: SE), a global technology company. Sea’s mission is to better the lives of consumers and small businesses with technology through its three core businesses: Shopee, Garena, and Monee.
